issue.title: gateway: codex=as-sent still widens spawn_agent's description (spawnAgentModels), so the relay's body isn't Codex's
issue.body:
A Codex turn to a custom Responses provider set `codex=as-sent` (#1758) is meant to reach the relay as Codex sent it, its model name alone swapped. One rewrite still applies to it: `spawnAgentModels` (`internal/gateway/codex_spawn_models.go`, called from `gateway.go` for every Codex `/v1/responses` request) widens the `multi_agent_v1` namespace's `spawn_agent` description with the catalog's models ("More models that may be set as `model`: ..."), re-encoding that tool.

Found while making as-sent hold when Codex offers `web_search` (maralica on Discord). `TestCodexAsSentWebSearch` compares the relay's body byte for byte with `testdata/workdir/codex-0.162.0.json`, and has to drop the `spawn_agent` tool from the fixture first, because its description differs:

```
TOOL multi_agent_v1 ... "description": "\n        \n        Available model overrides ... (+ the catalog's models)
```

Open question: should an as-sent provider skip `spawnAgentModels` too? A relay that checks a request is Codex's own (#1758) may look at tool descriptions; the cost of skipping is that a lead on that relay names only Codex's first five models to its subagents. Not changed in the web_search fix, which is scoped to the search translation.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3793-as-sent-spawn-agent` (head `f0d7a9cd`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — keep spawn_agent widening off when codex=as-sent.

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/gateway.go` widened `spawn_agent`'s description (`spawnAgentModels`) while handling, before the provider was chosen, and `codexAsSent` never saw it — so `codex=as-sent`, the user's setting that the body goes upstream exactly as Codex wrote it, was silently overridden for every Codex Responses request.

**Change.** the widening moved into `serve`, after the provider is chosen, and is gated on `!codexAsSent(c.p, r.Header)` for the Codex Responses path; the `codex_backend.go` caller keeps its behaviour (the ChatGPT backend is never as-sent). The default path still widens.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestCodexAsSentWebSearch` → the case had to drop `spawn_agent` from its fixture to pass: the widened body reached the upstream
Green: `same command → `ok` with the tool KEPT in the fixture and the body asserted byte-for-byte (no "Available model overrides" catalogue line); `TestSpawnAgentModelsLeavesTheRestAsSent` (the default path) stays green` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway`

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3793-as-sent-spawn-agent — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
